english: You see a strange glowing torch, a bit further down the hallway.
A torch! Go pick it up, someone could be in danger.
Meek feel... bad here. Very bad.
Are magical floating torches common? I feel like they are.
E-Maybe I'll just... go somewhere else.
Something... wrong! Meek not see, but Meek feel!
However, this is obviously not floating by itself.
Do not worry about simple esoteric magic items. Focus on yourself instead.
Why's there a bunch of other stuff floating in the air too?
Hm. You might just be a little paranoid.
There's nothing wrong with stopping to enjoy the view.
You look down the hallway, real close.
Then you look at the walls.
Wait... why is there no dirt on the ground?
There is absolutely no dust or grime or little rock pebbles on the ground here. Right in front of me.
And there's a bunch of floating stuff in the air in front of me. Stuff that looks like it's slowly being dissolved by some powerful agent.
That is a bad sign. In fact, it really sounds like...
A perfectly straight line, after which the dungeon floor is clean?
A perfectly flat wall of perfectly translucent gel stands before you.
The goblin stumbles backwards when he realizes what you're saying.
Yes, as in I do see something, or yes as in yes, I really don't see anything?
You see nothing. The hallway is safe.
No signs of trap floor-tiles. Or holes with poison darts.
Or giant blades that swing down from the ceiling.
This is just a normal hallway.
